note: Spaces navigation toolbar -- renders fixed application module names: Mail, Address Book, Calendar, Tasks, Chat, Settings, Collapse
Unified toolbar and window controls -- renders fixed UI labels: Search, App Menu, Minimize, Restore, Close; search input text is subtracted
Application menu bar -- renders fixed menu titles: File, Edit, View, Go, Message, Tasks, Help
Chat module toolbar -- renders fixed action labels: Add Buddy, Join Chat, Status, Accounts
Chat tab panel -- renders fixed placeholder text for empty state; contact list is subtracted as it contains user-defined names
Folder pane header controls -- renders fixed action labels: More, Write Message, Get Messages
Thread pane header controls -- renders fixed action labels: Quick Filter, Display; folder name and count are subtracted as they reflect user-defined folder names and message counts
Thunderbird start page -- renders fixed platform marketing copy, feature descriptions, and navigation links
Status bar -- renders fixed application status indicators and messages
